name: Customer

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the customer

fields.name: email
fields.description: Customer's email address for communication and login

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Customer's full name

fields.name: phoneNumber
fields.description: Primary contact phone number

fields.name: shippingAddress
fields.description: Default shipping address for order delivery

fields.name: registrationDate
fields.description: Date when customer account was created

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if customer account is active

constraints.customerId: Must be unique across all customers

description: Stores customer profiles with contact and shipping information for order processing

name: InventoryItem

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the inventory item

fields.name: productName
fields.description: Name of the product

fields.name: sku
fields.description: Stock Keeping Unit - unique product identifier

fields.name: quantityAvailable
fields.description: Current available stock quantity for sale

fields.name: quantityReserved
fields.description: Quantity reserved for pending orders

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: Price per unit of the product

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.description: Timestamp of last inventory update

constraints.sku: Must be unique across all inventory items

description: Tracks product inventory levels, reservations, and availability for order fulfillment

relationships.description: An inventory item can be referenced in multiple orders

name: Order

fields.name: orderId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the order

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer who placed the order

fields.name: orderItems
fields.description: List of line items with product details, quantities, and individual pricing

fields.name: totalAmount
fields.description: Total order value including all items, taxes, and fees

fields.name: orderStatus
fields.description: Current status of the order (pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled)

fields.name: paymentStatus
fields.description: Payment state (unpaid, paid, refunded, failed)

fields.name: shippingAddress
fields.description: Delivery address details including street, city, state, postal code, and country

fields.name: statusHistory
fields.description: Chronological log of status transitions with timestamps and notes

constraints.orderStatus: enum: pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled
constraints.paymentStatus: enum: unpaid, paid, refunded, failed, partial

description: Central data model capturing order details from submission through delivery, including items, pricing, and status tracking throughout the order lifecycle.
